$ labctl challenge list
CHALLENGE                           CATEGORY     PAR       DESCRIPTION
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
demo-challenge                      workload     10m       Demo challenge

$ labctl challenge info demo-challenge
Name:        demo-challenge
Display:     Demo challenge
Category:    workload
Par time:    10m
Hint cost:   5% per hint
Setup:       incident demo-fault

Fix the demo fault

$ labctl challenge status
No challenge is currently active.

$ labctl challenge history
No challenge history yet.

$ labctl challenge start demo-challenge
Challenge started: Demo challenge
Timer:    started at <time>
Par time: 10m

Fix the demo fault

When you think you've fixed it, run:
  labctl challenge submit

$ labctl challenge status
Challenge: demo-challenge
Name:      Demo challenge
Elapsed:   <dur>
Par:       10m (under by 10m)
Hints used: 0

$ labctl challenge submit

=== Challenge Result: Demo challenge ===

  ✗ marker-gone
      bash: exit status 1

Checks: 0/1 passed
Time:   <dur> (par: 10m)
Hints:  0 used
Score:  0/100
Outcome: failed

Still running. Fix what is listed above and submit again,
or give up and clean the lab with:  labctl challenge abort

$ labctl challenge history
No challenge history yet.

$ labctl challenge hint
[Hint 1/3 - -5% score penalty]

look at the pods

$ labctl challenge submit

=== Challenge Result: Demo challenge ===

  ✓ marker-gone

Checks: 1/1 passed
Time:   <dur> (par: 10m)
Hints:  1 used
Score:  95/100
Outcome: passed

Like finding these? The Kubernetes Incident Response Field Guide has the fix for more of them: https://labs.snowops.net/#updates

No challenge is currently active.

$ labctl incident status
